name: Release 0.2.11
body:
## What's Changed
* SmbusI801: Fix missing bitmask by @Steve-Tech in https://github.com/namazso/PawnIO.Modules/pull/91
* Add NVIDIA memory temperature sensors. by @Blacktempel in https://github.com/namazso/PawnIO.Modules/pull/89
* Initial commit of LedsValve.p, LED driver for Valve Steam Machine by @CalcProgrammer1 in https://github.com/namazso/PawnIO.Modules/pull/87
* RyzenSMU: Add Sensor monitoring support for pre-Ryzen CPUs, add more supported pre-Ryzen CPU codenames by @Erruar in https://github.com/namazso/PawnIO.Modules/pull/80
* Fix the NCT6798 device-ID mask by @tdmackey in https://github.com/namazso/PawnIO.Modules/pull/103
* Validate the NCT6793 SMBus base before I/O by @tdmackey in https://github.com/namazso/PawnIO.Modules/pull/99
* Reject the NCT6793 general-call address by @tdmackey in https://github.com/namazso/PawnIO.Modules/pull/101
* Fix i801 block-process response layout by @tdmackey in https://github.com/namazso/PawnIO.Modules/pull/100

## New Contributors

name: Release 0.2.0
body:
Starting with this release, the minor version will be bumped to clarify the lack of API stability guarantee across releases. Since the modules are bundled with the software using them, this shouldn't cause issues as all updates are explicit to downstream users.

## What's Changed
* AMD MSRs by @irusanov in https://github.com/namazso/PawnIO.Modules/pull/28
* AMD: Allow family 1Ah, add CPPC MSRs, support more codenames by @irusanov in https://github.com/namazso/PawnIO.Modules/pull/29
* Fixed low-high base Power Table address handling. Added 0x1Ah CPUs  by @Erruar in https://github.com/namazso/PawnIO.Modules/pull/33
* Isa Bridge EC by @namazso in https://github.com/namazso/PawnIO.Modules/pull/26

## New Contributors
* @irusanov made their first contribution in https://github.com/namazso/PawnIO.Modules/pull/28
* @Erruar made their first contribution in https://github.com/namazso/PawnIO.Modules/pull/33

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/namazso/PawnIO.Modules/compare/0.1.6...0.2.0
